reviews.text:
We had a great experience with the dog training program at ACA Center, offered through Miami-Dade Animal Services. Cesar and all the trainers were patient, knowledgeable, and gave us practical tools that made a real difference with our dog.

Our dog made great progress with obedience, attention, and socialization, and we also became much more confident as dog owners. It’s an excellent resource for families adopting from the shelter, and we’re very grateful it was available to us. Highly recommend!
Best place to train your dog through love and understanding!! Thanks for all your help to the A.C.A team!!!
Rescued my dog from the shelter and took him straight to ACA center to train him and the staff and especially Cesar have been nothing but excellent! He’s all trained and ready to go!!
Great team and experience! Loved learning how to handle my dog from shelter.

My dog finished her 6 free classes today that are offered by MDAS. At first I wasn’t sure how beneficial the classes would be as it sounded too good to be true, from the first class I already knew they would make a difference.
Cesar treats every dog and every class with so much passion, care, and respect. We worked on specific reactions and commands, and in just 6 classes, my dog and I left feeling more confident and knowledgeable. We now have the tools to continue reinforcing what we learned and, most importantly, apply it in real-life situations.
This experience also taught me how to better handle my dog so that I don’t unintentionally add to her stress when she’s in an overwhelming situation. I especially loved that these are group classes because they teach you how to keep your dog focused on you and waiting for the next command instead of reacting to the other dogs around them. It has been such a great way to strengthen the bond between my dog and me.
I genuinely recommend this training center to everyone, no matter what you and your dog may be working on. I’m so grateful we had the opportunity to be part of these classes 🐾🐾🤍
Amazing dog training my dog’s amazing out the words

I cannot describe how grateful I am to ACA Dog Training for what they have done for me and my dog Penny.

When I adopted my dog from Animal Services this year, she was dog reactive and difficult to walk on a leash. After my 6 sessions with ACA, Penny is an entirely different dog.

She attended group classes and continued to learn, grow, and in my opinion, excel. Not only is Penny better, but I am a much better handler to help guide her through every day life. The bond we share has only deepened and it is because of the wonderful people and the time we have all put into my dog.

I now have the confidence and skills to properly handle my dog anywhere we go, even my neighbors have noticed how well behaved she is now.

If you have to choice, bring your dog here. They will take excellent care of them and you will learn so much. I cannot recommend them enough.

I had seen nothing but great reviews about this place, so I decided to bring my dog in for a consultation, even knowing that it would be expensive. Unfortunately, I left extremely disappointed with my experience.

Throughout the consultation, I felt that they were overly critical of everything I was doing with my dog, and at one point, they yelled at my dog. What concerned me even more was what I witnessed during the consultation. Their demo dog was running around with its ears and tail tucked, which appeared to me to be signs of fear or stress.

They also intentionally had another dog bark in my dog’s face to see how my dog would react around other dogs. I had made it very clear that my dog does not have any behavioral issues, so I hope this is not a standard method they use with dogs who do. A situation like that could escalate very quickly and potentially become dangerous.

I went in expecting a professional and experienced dog trainer, and instead, I left questioning their methods and how they handle dogs in their care. Based on my personal experience, I would not feel comfortable trusting these trainers with my dog.

From start to finish my training sessions were amazing.i got the 6 sessions since my pup was from the shelter. I loved working with everyone there and they were very patient with my dog. Denji came in scared and barking at everyone and they helped me control that and showed me how to control him when he got like that. At first Denji was always scared to go to his trainings but after his second class he was always excited to go in there. Definitely recommend them for training they are all very knowledgeable.

We had 6 free classes for our dog because she was rescued from the shelter and the ACA team did such a fantastic job, excellent classes, loved our dog, we learnt so many tricks, she behaves so much better, we can’t recommend it enough!!!
